"""Pure RAW BELOW BODY ACF recovery proof; no financial or data-provider capabilities."""

from copy import deepcopy
import ast
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet, StrategyCandidate, StrategyRuntime, implementation_sha256
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
SOURCE = HERE / "strategy_runtime"
PARENTS = ("range_reversion", "adaptive_range", "confirmed_range", "reentry_confirmed_range")
FILES = [
    "strategies/" + p + ".py" for p in (*PARENTS, "bear_time_below_recovery_range", "__init__")
]


def load(source, name, file):
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(source / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name + "." + file, source / "strategies" / (file + ".py")
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main():
    checks = []

    def check(name, ok=True):
        assert ok, name
        checks.append(name)

    def refuse(name, call):
        try:
            call()
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            checks.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected rejection: " + name)

    oldsource = ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/src/strategy_runtime"
    new = load(SOURCE, "_ex055_new", "bear_time_below_recovery_range")
    old = load(oldsource, "_ex055_old", "reentry_confirmed_range")
    plan = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json").read_text("utf-8")
    )
    center = deepcopy(
        next(
            c["payload"]["parameters"]
            for c in plan["configurations"]
            if c["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
        )
    )
    p = {**deepcopy(center), "mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    prior_tree = ast.parse(
        (
            ROOT
            / ".tmp/ex054-raw-body-prototype/strategy_runtime/strategies/bear_time_below_body_range.py"
        ).read_text("utf-8")
    )
    new_tree = ast.parse(
        (SOURCE / "strategies/bear_time_below_recovery_range.py").read_text("utf-8")
    )

    def branch_body(tree, name):
        node = next(
            n
            for n in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(n, ast.If) and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name) and n.test.id == name
        )
        return ast.dump(ast.Module(body=node.body, type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False)

    check(
        "held state/age/anchor/peak and all final exit priority AST54 exact",
        branch_body(prior_tree, "holding") == branch_body(new_tree, "holding"),
    )
    check(
        "successful entry anchor and context consumption AST54 exact",
        branch_body(prior_tree, "passed") == branch_body(new_tree, "passed"),
    )
    check(
        "no extra direction rejection source",
        not any(
            isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and n.value == "entry_direction_rejected"
            for n in ast.walk(new_tree)
        ),
    )
    native = new.BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(p))
    parent = old.ReentryConfirmedRange(ParameterSet(center))
    check("numeric center and parent warmup180 exact", native._warmup == parent._warmup == 180)
    for file in PARENTS:
        check(
            "parent byte exact " + file,
            (SOURCE / "strategies" / (file + ".py")).read_bytes()
            == (oldsource / "strategies" / (file + ".py")).read_bytes(),
        )
    payload = {
        "parameters": p,
        "runtime": {
            "contract_version": 1,
            "module": "strategy_runtime.strategies.bear_time_below_recovery_range",
            "qualname": "BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange",
            "source_files": FILES,
            "source_sha256": implementation_sha256(FILES, source_root=SOURCE),
        },
    }
    bound = StrategyRuntime().describe(StrategyCandidate("S013", "C7580", payload, SOURCE))
    check(
        "public authenticated prospective describe only",
        bound.parameters.sha256 == ParameterSet(p).sha256,
    )
    rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
    dates = pd.bdate_range("2018-01-01", periods=740)
    prices = 10 * np.exp(np.cumsum(rng.normal(0.0001, 0.02, len(dates))))
    bars = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Date": dates,
            "Close": prices,
            "Open": prices * 0.999,
            "High": prices * 1.01,
            "Low": prices * 0.99,
            "Volume": np.exp(rng.normal(14, 0.3, len(dates))),
            "Amount": np.exp(rng.normal(18, 0.3, len(dates))),
        }
    )
    sessions = dates[400:]
    history = native.calculate_history({"daily": bars}, sessions)
    baseline = parent.calculate_history({"daily": bars}, sessions)
    added = {
        "last_exit_reason",
        "last_exit_route",
        "last_exit_category",
        "entry_direction_gate_applies",
        "entry_direction_up",
        "previous_signal_close",
        "entry_signal_close",
        "entry_signal_open",
        "bear_acf_raw",
        "entry_acf_value",
        "entry_acf_pass",
        "entry_acf_recovery_applies",
        "entry_eligible",
    }
    check(
        "only declared schema additions no mean or previous regime",
        set(history) - set(baseline) == added and not set(baseline) - set(history),
    )
    static = [
        "acf1",
        "close",
        "momentum20",
        "regime",
        "regime_momentum",
        "bull_range_position",
        "bear_range_position",
        "confirmation_score",
        "confirmation_acf",
        "confirmation_turnover",
        "confirmation_volume",
        "confirmation_pass",
    ]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(history[static], baseline[static], check_exact=True)
    check("all raw features original score and routing exact")
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(history.entry_direction_up, bars.Close.gt(bars.Open).iloc[400:])
    check("first selected previousClose from full history")
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
        native.calculate_history({"daily": bars.iloc[:560]}, dates[400:560]),
        history.iloc[:160],
        check_exact=True,
    )
    changed = bars.copy()
    changed.loc[560:, ["Open", "Close", "High", "Low", "Volume", "Amount"]] *= 1.7
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
        native.calculate_history({"daily": changed}, sessions).iloc[:160],
        history.iloc[:160],
        check_exact=True,
    )
    check("all schema exact prefix and future OHLCVA causality")
    opening_only = bars.copy()
    opening_only.loc[560:, "Open"] *= 1.4
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
        native.calculate_history({"daily": opening_only}, sessions).iloc[:160],
        history.iloc[:160],
        check_exact=True,
    )
    check("future Open alone cannot change any prior BODY context column")

    def controlled(
        closes, *, positions=None, acf=0.2, score=0.0, override=None, opens=None, mom=0.0
    ):
        params = deepcopy(p)
        params["regime_threshold"] = 0.2
        if override:
            override(params)
        count = len(closes)
        data = bars.iloc[: 400 + count].copy()
        data.loc[380:399, "Close"] = 10.0
        data.loc[400:, "Close"] = closes
        data.loc[400:, "Open"] = np.asarray(closes) + 1.0 if opens is None else opens
        data["High"] = data[["Open", "Close"]].max(axis=1) * 1.01
        data["Low"] = data[["Open", "Close"]].min(axis=1) * 0.99
        days = dates[400 : 400 + count]
        all_days = pd.DatetimeIndex(data.Date)
        ranges = np.full(len(data), 0.5)
        if positions is not None:
            ranges[-count:] = positions
        acfs = np.full(len(data), 0.2)
        acfs[-count:] = acf
        scores = np.full(len(data), 0.0)
        scores[-count:] = score
        momenta = np.full(len(data), 0.0)
        momenta[-count:] = mom
        feature = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "range_position": ranges,
                "acf1": acfs,
                "close": data.Close.to_numpy(),
                "momentum20": momenta,
            },
            index=all_days,
        )
        normalized = pd.DataFrame(
            {"acf": scores, "turnover": scores, "volume": scores}, index=all_days
        )

        def components(_bars, _window):
            return feature.copy()

        def confirmation(_bars, _acf, _window):
            return normalized.copy(), normalized.copy()

        model = new.BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(params))
        parent = old.ReentryConfirmedRange(
            ParameterSet({k: v for k, v in params.items() if k != "mechanism"})
        )
        with (
            patch.object(new, "components", components),
            patch.object(new, "confirmation_features", confirmation),
        ):
            frame = model.calculate_history({"daily": data}, days)
        with (
            patch.object(old, "components", components),
            patch.object(old, "confirmation_features", confirmation),
        ):
            original = parent.calculate_history({"daily": data}, days)
        return frame, original

    def reasons(name, closes, expected, **kwargs):
        frame, parent = controlled(closes, **kwargs)
        check(name, frame.signal_reason.tolist() == expected)
        check(
            name + " no extra direction veto",
            not frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.any()
            and not frame.signal_reason.eq("entry_direction_rejected").any(),
        )
        return frame, parent

    def h1(q):
        q["bear"]["max_hold"] = 1

    for exitprice, category in ((8.0, "BELOW"), (9.0, "EQUAL"), (10.0, "ABOVE")):
        frame, parent = reasons(
            category + " originalACFpass bodydown never suppressed",
            [9.0, exitprice, exitprice],
            ["entry", "time", "entry"],
            override=h1,
        )
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(frame[list(parent.columns)], parent, check_exact=True)
        check(
            category + " classification beforedecision and no recovery",
            frame.last_exit_category.iloc[2] == category
            and not frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.any(),
        )
    reasons(
        "no prior context rawACFfail bodyup remains flat", [9.0], ["flat"], acf=0.099, opens=[8.0]
    )
    frame, parent = reasons(
        "BELOW BODYup originalACFfail restores eligibility only",
        [9.0, 8.0, 8.0, 8.0],
        ["entry", "time", "entry", "time"],
        acf=[0.2, 0.2, 0.099, 0.099],
        opens=[10.0, 10.0, 7.0, 7.0],
        override=h1,
    )
    check(
        "recovered flag retains original cutoff failure",
        frame.entry_acf_value.iloc[2] == 0.099
        and not frame.entry_acf_pass.iloc[2]
        and frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2]
        and frame.entry_eligible.iloc[2]
        and frame.confirmation_opportunity.iloc[2],
    )
    check("original path cannot enter restored day", parent.signal_reason.iloc[2] == "flat")
    check(

            frame[col].iloc[3] is None

        )
        and frame.signal_reason.iloc[3] == "time"
        and parent.signal_reason.iloc[3] == "flat",
    )
    check(

"""S013 causal dual-route range strategy; routing uses only known daily closes."""
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import replace
import math

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import InputContract, ParameterSet

from .range_reversion import RangeReversion, components


class AdaptiveRange(RangeReversion):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if set(p) != {'bull', 'bear', 'regime_window', 'regime_threshold',
                      'exit_on_regime_change'}:
            raise ValueError('exact adaptive parameter contract required')
        if type(p['regime_window']) is not int or not 5 <= p['regime_window'] <= 60:
            raise ValueError('regime_window must be 5..60 sessions')
        if (type(p['regime_threshold']) is not float
                or not math.isfinite(p['regime_threshold'])
                or not -.2 <= p['regime_threshold'] <= .2):
            raise ValueError('regime_threshold must be a finite float in [-.2,.2]')
        if type(p['exit_on_regime_change']) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('exit_on_regime_change must be bool')
        for key in ('bull', 'bear'):
            if not isinstance(p[key], Mapping):
                raise ValueError(key + ' must contain complete range parameters')
        self._routes = {
            key: RangeReversion(ParameterSet(p[key])) for key in ('bull', 'bear')
        }
        if p['bull']['limit_premium'] != p['bear']['limit_premium']:
            raise ValueError('route limit_premium must be identical')
        self._parameters = parameters
        self._warmup = max(p['bull']['range_window'], p['bear']['range_window'],
                           p['regime_window'] + 1, 21)

    @property
    def definition(self):
        base = self._routes['bull'].definition
        requirements = tuple(
            replace(item, lookback_sessions=self._warmup)
            if item.name == 'daily' else item for item in base.inputs.requirements
        )
        return replace(base, parameters=self._parameters,
                       inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calendar_request(self, window):
        return super().calendar_request(window)

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        route_features = {
            key: components(inputs['daily'], p[key]['range_window']).reindex(sessions)
            for key in ('bull', 'bear')
        }
        for feature in route_features.values():
            if not np.isfinite(feature.to_numpy()).all():
                raise ValueError('required causal route features missing')
        bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        regime_momentum = (close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(regime_momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('required causal regime features missing')
        regimes = np.where(regime_momentum.to_numpy() >= p['regime_threshold'],
                           'bull', 'bear')
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        age = cooldown = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = route_features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            reason = 'flat'
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
                trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
                changed = p['exit_on_regime_change'] and regime != active_route
                if loss or trail or row.range_position >= rp['exit'] or age >= rp['max_hold'] or changed:
                    holding = False
                    cooldown = rp['cooldown']
                    reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else
                              'range' if row.range_position >= rp['exit'] else
                              'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime')
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = 'hold'
            elif cooldown:
                cooldown -= 1
                reason = 'cooldown'
            elif (row.range_position <= rp['entry']
                  and (rp['acf_min'] is None or row.acf1 >= rp['acf_min'])
                  and (rp['momentum_min'] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp['momentum_min'])):
                holding = True
                active_route = regime
                age = 0
                anchor = peak = row.close
                reason = 'entry'
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        return route_features['bull'].assign(
            range_position=positions, target_position=targets, signal_reason=reasons,
            regime=regimes, regime_momentum=regime_momentum,
            bull_range_position=route_features['bull'].range_position,
            bear_range_position=route_features['bear'].range_position)

"""Original raw ACF with a local BODY-up recovery exception after BELOW bear TIME exits."""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet
from .reentry_confirmed_range import ReentryConfirmedRange
from .confirmed_range import PROFILES, confirmation_features
from .range_reversion import components


class BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange(ReentryConfirmedRange):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if p.get("mechanism") != "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY":
            raise ValueError("explicit raw bear TIME BELOW body ACF recovery mechanism required")
        if p.get("confirmation", {}).get("enabled") is not True:
            raise ValueError("original buy confirmation must remain enabled")
        super().__init__(
            ParameterSet({key: value for key, value in p.items() if key != "mechanism"})
        )
        self._parameters = parameters

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        c, settings = p["confirmation"], p["context"]
        daily = inputs["daily"]
        if not {"Date", "Open", "Close"}.issubset(daily.columns):
            raise ValueError("complete signal Date/Open/Close required")
        prices = daily.loc[:, ["Open", "Close"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        if not np.isfinite(prices).all() or (prices <= 0).any():
            raise ValueError("signal Open/Close must be finite and positive")
        all_features = {
            key: components(inputs["daily"], p[key]["range_window"]) for key in ("bull", "bear")
        }
        raw_bear_acf = all_features["bear"].acf1
        features = {key: frame.reindex(sessions) for key, frame in all_features.items()}
        if not all(np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy()).all() for frame in features.values()):
            raise ValueError("required causal route features missing")
        score_bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        if settings["volume_basis"] == "RAW":
            raw = inputs["execution"].copy()
            raw.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(raw.Date)).normalize()
            score_bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(score_bars.Date)).normalize()
            if (
                not raw.index.is_unique
                or not raw.index.is_monotonic_increasing
                or not raw.index.isin(score_bars.index).all()
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "raw volume dates must be unique, ordered and share the adjusted calendar"
                )
            adjusted = score_bars.loc[raw.index]
            reconstructed = adjusted.Volume * adjusted.Close / raw.Close
            if not np.allclose(
                reconstructed.to_numpy(), raw.Volume.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("per-date raw/HFQ volume conversion differs")
            if not np.allclose(
                adjusted.Amount.to_numpy(), raw.Amount.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("amount must be invariant across price-unit conversion")
            score_bars = adjusted.assign(Volume=raw.Volume)
        _, normalized = confirmation_features(score_bars, all_features["bull"].acf1, c["lookback"])
        normalized = normalized.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all():

    'turnover_volume': ('turnover', 'volume'), 'all': ('acf', 'turnover', 'volume'),
}


def causal_rank(values, window):
    """S007-v1 midrank formula; complete trailing window, centered on zero."""
    def last(items):
        current = items[-1]
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < current)
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == current)) / len(items) - .5)
    return values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).apply(last, raw=True)


def confirmation_features(bars, acf, window):
    frame = bars.copy()
    frame.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.Date)).normalize()
    volume, amount = frame.Volume.astype(float), frame.Amount.astype(float)
    if not np.isfinite(volume).all() or not np.isfinite(amount).all() or (volume <= 0).any() or (amount <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError('confirmation requires finite positive volume and amount')
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=frame.index)
    return raw, raw.apply(lambda values: causal_rank(values, window))
